chance.note:
Average precision of a random ranking equals the class positive rate, so this is the mean per-class positive rate over the BABEL-60 validation windows. Computed from the annotations, so it is protocol-independent and applies to a fine-tune exactly as it does to a probe.

The probe report's other two baselines are deliberately absent. `moments` and `random encoder` are both frozen-readout numbers; a fine-tune trains the backbone, so neither is the same measurement and a dashed line would invite the comparison anyway.
